sql.if: WHERE INSTR(LOWER(c.community_title), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(c.community_nickname), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0

mapper.select: SELECT "postNum", "title", "content", "author", "category", "createdAt" FROM ( SELECT c.community_id AS "postNum", c.community_title AS "title", c.community_content AS "content", c.community_nickname AS "author", c.community_category AS "category", c.community_date AS "createdAt", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.community_id DESC) AS rn FROM community_section c ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} ORDER BY rn
SELECT community_id FROM community_section WHERE community_id = #{num} FOR UPDATE
